
# Function domains: under --additional-axioms lambdas carry their parameter types as domain tags,
# {:functionDomain} declarations give Restrict and ExactDom, and --function-extensionality-axiom makes
# total functions of one argument with the same exact domain equal when they agree on it
# (https://github.com/erniecohen/dafny/issues/374).
